en.headline: Firefighters receive upgraded tracking devices after Tai Po fire inquiry
en.dek: The Fire Services Department has issued 2,000 new two-in-one devices costing HK$8.4 million that allow teammates to detect a distress signal within 500 metres.
body: The Fire Services Department has issued upgraded tracking devices to about 2,000 firefighters after an independent inquiry into last year’s Tai Po fire exposed technical limitations in the previous system, the South China Morning Post reported.

The department spent HK$8.4 million on the new Firefighter Tracking Devices, each costing more than HK$4,000, which combine functions so that teammates can detect a distress signal within 500 metres without a separate handheld receiver.
The devices were rolled out from 1 November, about a year after the Wang Fuk Court blaze in which firefighter Ho Wai-ho lost contact with his comrades before becoming one of the 168 people killed.
The upgrade aims to help locate personnel in distress more effectively during operations.

zh.headline: 大埔火後消防處向約2000名消防員派發升級定位裝置
zh.dek: 消防處耗資840萬元購置新式二合一裝置，讓隊友可在500米範圍內偵測求救訊號，無需額外手提接收器。
body: 據《南華早報》報道，消防處已向約2000名消防員派發升級定位裝置，去年大埔宏福苑大火的獨立調查揭露舊系統的技術限制後作出改善。
部門耗資840萬元購置新式消防員追蹤裝置，每部成本超過4000元，可讓隊友在500米範圍內偵測求救訊號，無需另備手提接收器。
裝置自11月1日起陸續配備，距宏福苑大火約一年；該場火災中消防員何偉豪一度與隊友失聯，其後成為168名罹難者之一。
升級旨在提升行動期間定位遇險人員的效率。
